name: Colosseum Inspired UI Overhaul
author: Community
description: Colosseum-inspired UI overhaul for Gen1Recomp. 2.2.5 centers live Pokemon type indicators in the shared Gen1/Gen2 battle HUD and mirrors the same single/dual-type treatment onto the player HP card. 2.2.4 Gen2 flash suppression and Gen1 Colosseum information-model performance improvements, 2.2.3 Pokedex routing, and 2.2.2 sprite-provider parity remain intact.
